title: TURNSTILE_SECRET is read only via the applied secrets facade and never inlined in fixture source
asA: reviewer auditing the applied Workers project for secret hygiene
iWant: the TURNSTILE_SECRET to be dereferenced only via process.env or an env-shaped facade and no plain-text secret literal in the fixture source
soThat: the Turnstile secret is never committed to the applying project source tree

acceptanceCriteria.description: A source-tree AST scan of the pack fixture (packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/probe-pack-edge-cloudflare-turnstile) asserts that TURNSTILE_SECRET is read only via env-shaped identifiers (process.env.TURNSTILE_SECRET or an env facade) and that no plain-string secret literal appears in the fixture source; the Node probe secret-shape-scan implements the assertion and exits 0.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the shipped pack fixture with the pinned test secrets sourced from environment
acceptanceCriteria.when: the source-tree AST scan runs over the fixture
acceptanceCriteria.then: the scan finds only env-shaped reads for TURNSTILE_SECRET and reports no plain-string secret literal

description: Story owns the secret-shape-scan probe (env-shaped reads only, no plain-string secret literal in the pack fixture source). Per section 7a, this story carries a single AC because the source-scan mechanism has no additional documented failure path in the guide or the anchored TAC.
